description: This file defines the interface IRuntimeManager for managing runtime applications, including lifecycle operations, notifications, and configuration structures within the WPEFramework Exchange namespace.

classes.name: RuntimeConfig
classes.description: Configuration structure for runtime environment parameters, including resource limits, environment variables, and debug settings.

classes.name: IRuntimeManager
classes.description: Interface for managing runtime application containers, providing methods for lifecycle control, notifications, and configuration.

classes.name: IRuntimeManager::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for runtime events such as start, termination, failure, and state changes.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for runtime events.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts a runtime application with specified parameters and configuration.

methods.name: Wake
methods.description: Wakes the application to a specified runtime state.

methods.name: GetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the application, such as resource usage.

methods.name: Annotate
methods.description: Adds metadata annotations to the application.

methods.name: Mount
methods.description: Mounts a directory or device inside the container.

methods.name: Unmount
methods.description: Unmounts a directory or device inside the container.
